title: Transfer of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty to a Subsequent Owner
content:
**Terms of transfer.**

(a) Where the program allows transfer, a subsequent owner of the home may register for the remaining Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage.

(b) A subsequent owner is enrolled only when the registration is received within the program's transfer registration days, in calendar days, after the subsequent owner's deed date. Counting starts the day after the deed date and the last counted day is included.

(c) The subsequent owner keeps the home's program and every original end date, because a transfer does not restart any coverage period. The program's transfer fee is assessed on the new coverage, and the previous owner's coverage moves to transferred on the deed date.

(d) A subsequent owner who registers late is not enrolled, and items they report are denied with reason "not registered".

(e) The test in (b) rests on the subsequent owner's deed date and the date the registration is received, together with the home's coverage records; the registration is matched to the home by the purchase agreement under which Calloway sold it.

## Registration window, hypothetical dates (60-day registration period)

| Deed date | Registration received | Calendar days after the deed date | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 January 2026 | 6 March 2026 | 60 | Enrolled; transfer fee assessed on the new coverage; previous coverage transferred as of 5 January 2026 |
| 5 January 2026 | 7 March 2026 | 61 | Not enrolled; items reported denied, not registered |

**Basis Q&A.**
- *Do the subsequent owner's periods start again from the deed date?* No; the program and every original end date carry over unchanged.
- *On which coverage is the transfer fee assessed?* On the subsequent owner's new coverage.
